hard_legos.statement: The physical 5x4 k4 winning-line set has 17 lines: 8 horizontal, 5 vertical, 4 diagonal.
Only identity and horizontal reflection among the 120 column permutations preserve the fixed physical 5x4 winning-line hypergraph.
The witness uses nonphysical canonicalizers: 10 of 14 canonicalizer uses are not fixed-board automorphisms.
All 12 displayed witness canonical states contain at least one transported residual that is not a subset of any physical winning line in that displayed frame.
Every one of the six stored two-sheet witness groups contains two exact states in distinct arbitrary-column residual orbits.
Every one of those six exact sheet pairs has identical complete literal-action future behavior in its canonical frame under the audited pruned transition semantics.
Therefore all six stored binary fibers collapse to one class at literal-future behavior resolution; the local witness has no two-sheet carrier at that resolution.
In one common source frame, Route A and Route B endpoints are exact/orbit/literal-future distinct but become literal-future equivalent under an explicit global action relabeling.
The stored edge on which delta=1 appears is gauge-dependent; an independent exact-state sheet gauge moves the flip from edge 2710 to edge 2724 while preserving odd total route difference.
The six exact witness transitions, canonicalizer sets, permutation parity sets, source-frame action sequences and accumulated transporter parity sets replay independently.
Support-release/turn-capacity agrees with exhaustive isolated alternating-turn/gravity feasibility on all 56 residual occurrences in the witness states; this is not full-game realizability.
On the declared repaired 5x4 representation graph the Z2 edge cochain is non-exact, with cycle rank 542 and exactly one directed opposite-parity reconvergent source-target pair.
The count of nonzero fundamental-basis cycles is not invariant: tested spanning orders yield 22, 28, 32, 35, or 115. Non-exactness, not the count 22, is the invariant scalar conclusion.
The flat 4x5 repaired carrier is independently exact for every tested basis order and has cycle rank 40.
The recursive canonical-frame action-token construction omits the child canonicalizing transporter when recursively aligning action labels.
Static transpose, k, closure, deep merge, coarse-cycle descriptors and single-residual realizability were already falsified as complete explanations before this audit.

soft_legos.statement: The observed non-exact cochain may be discrete holonomy of changing canonical coordinate frames rather than a game-state invariant.
Omitted transporter alignment may be sufficient to generate the stored binary sheet distinctions.
A transporter-complete quotient could still possess a different nontrivial holonomy; the witness-level collapse does not rule this out globally.
Gravity-relative order may remain relevant after correct transport, but current evidence no longer licenses treating it as the cause of the audited Z2 anomaly.
Residual-incidence/cap-hole motifs may describe representation-fiber structure rather than intrinsic physical Connect4 state.
The quotient may be too coarse for one question and simultaneously too fine for another: it erases exact residual state while retaining frame-dependent action-token distinctions.

missing_legos.statement: Edge transporter retained as first-class data in the recursive action-labelled/future signature.
A full-carrier partition by transporter-aware complete future behavior.
Accumulated root-to-state transporter/provenance mapping each canonical residual hyperedge back to a physical Connect4 frame.
An explicit identity theory for when two abstract residual states related by arbitrary action relabeling count as the same object for the target theorem.
A physically restricted quotient using only actual board automorphisms (identity/reflection) for comparison with the arbitrary-column abstract quotient.
A qualified bridge, if any, from representation/groupoid holonomy to game value, proof identity, or solver-relevant structure.

inventory_conclusion: The Lego inventory no longer points first to a mysterious local game transition. It points first to a quotient-with-changing-frames problem: exact states are transported into independently canonicalized abstract frames, the recursive labelled signature omits the transporter, and the resulting representation graph carries a non-exact Z2 cochain.
